newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss tightening depends on economy, forex - SNB.
newsitem.headline: Swiss tightening depends on economy, forex - SNB.

text.p: Swiss National Bank Chairman Hans Meyer said the timing of any future tightening of monetary policy would depend on the state of the economy and the Swiss franc's foreign exchange rates.

"When it comes to choosing the proper time there are two factors especially which must be considered: the state of the Swiss economy and development in the exchange rate, which for the foreseeable future will depend mainly on events pertaining to the plan for European monetary union," he said in the text of an address to be delivered at the SNB's news conference.
